notes.subject: feat(chat): fork an in-progress chat with /fork
notes.summary: You can now run /fork on a chat that is still running; the fork snapshots it as if stopped at that moment, marks unfinished tools and pending questions as interrupted, skips queued messages, and /fork from the slash menu now runs immediately.
